qualifications: Independent control uses the same new renderer, pixels and nuisance span as linked fits; it is not the exact published 0.3 or 0.10 estimator.
Raw/reference color, PRISM LSF, spectral variability, true per-pixel response, ePSF tails and shared systematics remain unvalidated.
Point shifts are model sensitivity, not accuracy improvement. No RMS/coverage claim is available from one known object.
GN/H covariance is conditional on final robust weights and diagonal native variance. No calibrated confidence or detection probability.
Final-mode delta-chi2 threshold is a numerical heuristic; no nominal likelihood coverage is assigned.
No prospective calibration/validation/holdout field is opened.
rules.reference_spectrum: Fnu(lambda)/Fnu(local)=(lambda/local)^alpha; explicitly hypothetical, not a verified SPHEREx convention
rules.registration: reuse frozen Gaia frame offsets, fixed during fits; covariance excluded from reported centroid-only matrices
rules.response: Cent channel curve shifted to nearest-source-pixel center; no width dilation or pixel-footprint response integration
rules.scope: 20 already opened WISE QR2 wide cutouts; two overlapping frozen configurations, not 24 independent exposures or unseen fields
rules.selection: all 28 epoch attempts retained, including preparation/fit failures; no model selected from results
rules.spectrum: MAST PRISM only; not merged, deconvolved, rescaled or made into astronomical truth
rules.time_model: one position per epoch; within-season proper motion/parallax not modeled in this isolated comparison
